kinds.d: Detachable or fixed container that feeds cartridges into a firearm.
Replacement or upgrade barrel made to fit a firearm model or platform.
Drop-in trigger or trigger group made to fit a firearm model or platform.
Fixed or adjustable open or aperture sight fitted to a firearm, sold as front, rear or set.
Device fitted to a firearm muzzle that reduces the sound of a shot; its legal class varies by place.

notes: All five kinds kept at platform level. Magazine cut from 7 Magpul models to 5 (dropped PMAG MOE, superseded by Gen M3, and PMAG D-60 drum). No OEM magazine models added (none in old data).
